scope: Complete pinned upstream api.proto codec reference; no Nakama API, process or native DB execution. Invalid API values are retained strictly as codec diagnostics.

cases.purpose: Empty repeated write field.

cases.textproto: objects { collection: "profile" key: "k" value: "{}" }
cases.purpose: Both Int32Value wrappers absent; application defaults are not applied by the codec.

cases.textproto: objects { collection: "profile" key: "k" value: "{}" permission_read { value: 0 } permission_write { value: 0 } }
cases.purpose: Both explicit-zero wrappers remain present as zero-length nested messages.

cases.textproto: objects { collection: "profile" key: "k" value: "{}" permission_read {} }
cases.purpose: Present zero read wrapper differs from omitted write wrapper.

cases.textproto: objects { collection: "profile" key: "k" value: "{}" permission_write {} }
cases.purpose: Omitted read wrapper differs from present zero write wrapper.

cases.textproto: objects { collection: "profile" key: "k" value: "{}" permission_read { value: 1 } permission_write { value: 1 } }
cases.purpose: Explicit 1/1 wrappers have nonempty nested payloads.

cases.textproto: objects { collection: "profile" key: "k" value: "{}" permission_read { value: 2 } permission_write { value: 1 } }
cases.purpose: Maximum public API read/write permission values.

cases.textproto: objects { collection: "profile" key: "k" value: "{}" permission_read { value: -1 } permission_write { value: -2147483648 } }
cases.purpose: Negative int32 and minimum int32 values encode unchanged; API rejection is not executed.

cases.textproto: objects { collection: "profile" key: "k" value: "{}" permission_read { value: 3 } permission_write { value: 2 } }
cases.purpose: Values outside API ACL ranges remain legal protobuf int32 values; API rejection is not executed.

cases.textproto: objects { collection: "profile" key: "k" value: "{}" permission_read { value: 2147483647 } permission_write { value: 2147483647 } }
cases.purpose: Maximum signed int32 values are preserved without narrowing; API rejection is not executed.

cases.textproto: objects { collection: "profile" key: "k" value: "{}" version: "*" }
cases.purpose: Write create-only version marker is carried as an ordinary exact string.

cases.textproto: objects { collection: "profile/雪" key: " k\t\"\\" value: " {\"amount\": 9007199254740993, \"tiny\": 0.0000000000000000001, \"dup\":1,\"dup\":2,\"escaped\":\"\\u0061\",\"unicode\":\"雪\"} \n" version: " OpaqueABC*/雪\n" }
cases.purpose: UTF-8, whitespace, escapes, duplicate JSON members, precision-sensitive number spellings and opaque version bytes are not parsed or normalized by the codec.

objects { collection: "profile" key: "k" value: "{}" version: "*" }
objects { collection: "profile" key: "k" value: " { } " version: "OpaqueABC" permission_read {} permission_write { value: 1 } }
cases.purpose: Repeated same-key inputs retain order, values, versions and distinct wrapper presence.

cases.textproto: objects {  }

Empty repeated delete field.

cases.textproto: object_ids { collection: "profile" key: "k" version: "*" }

cases.textproto: object_ids { collection: "profile" key: "k" version: " OpaqueABC*/雪\n" }

Repeated duplicate targets and their exact version sequence remain intact.

cases.textproto: object_ids {}

Empty repeated acknowledgements field.

cases.textproto: acks { collection: "profile" key: "k" version: "OpaqueABC" user_id: "abcdefab-cdef-abcd-efab-cdefabcdefab" create_time { seconds: -1 nanos: 999999000 } update_time { seconds: 1700000000 nanos: 123456000 } }

cases.textproto: acks { collection: "profile" key: "k" version: "" user_id: "abcdefab-cdef-abcd-efab-cdefabcdefab" create_time {} update_time {} }
cases.purpose: Present zero timestamps are nested empty messages; explicit empty scalar version is omitted on the wire.

acks { collection: "profile" key: "z" version: "FirstABC" user_id: "abcdefab-cdef-abcd-efab-cdefabcdefab" create_time { seconds: 1 nanos: 1 } update_time { seconds: 2 nanos: 999999999 } }
acks { collection: "profile" key: "a" version: "SecondDEF" user_id: "abcdefab-cdef-abcd-efab-cdefabcdefab" create_time { seconds: 3 nanos: 1000 } update_time { seconds: 4 nanos: 1000000 } }
